A '''carrot cupcake''' is the meal of the [[carrot]]. It heals {{Hp|8}} and grants {{EffectLink|Night Vision}} for 10 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/carrot_cupcake.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A carrot, sugar, estus ash, cocoa beans and dough. Picking up a carrot unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a carrot cupcake takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|8}} and gives Night Vision for 10:00.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_7.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
